Static vs Dynamic IP Address: Which One Do You Actually Need?

Quick thread 🧵
A static IP address stays the same for the life of the device or server.
A dynamic IP is handed out temporarily by DHCP and can change when the lease renews.
Home connections are dynamic because it is cheaper and simpler.
Servers want a static IP so DNS records, firewalls, and mail keep working.
